description: This file defines the interface for the STUN (Simple Traversal of UDP Through NATs) Client Station Object, including function prototypes for creation, removal, and initialization of the object, as well as external functions.

methods.name: StunCreateSimpleClient
methods.description: Creates a simple STUN client object with the given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: StunScoCreate
methods.description: Creates a STUN Client Station Object with the specified contexts.

methods.name: StunScoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified STUN Client Station Object.

methods.name: StunScoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects necessary for the STUN Client Station Object.

methods.name: StunScoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the STUN Client Station Object.
